name: catastro-gps-mcp
description: Cadastral parcels in 31 European countries and regions: reference, coordinates, Spanish address, geometry, solar, agriculture, market, score and comparison.
long_description: One API key for official cadastral data across 29 European countries plus the Basque Country and Navarre. Look up parcels by reference or coordinates, turn a Spanish postal address into a cadastral reference, get parcel outlines as GeoJSON, estimate solar and agricultural potential, read aggregated market prices (France, Italy, Germany), score and compare parcels, and follow how a parcel changes over time. Free tier: 250 calls per month, and failed lookups are not charged.
